title: Chain phase visibility in Mission Control: show current phase, next phase, approval requirement, and phase history clearly
goal: Assessment chain execution (api/app/services/assessment_chain.py) is a sophisticated 4-phase system with auto-advance and approval gating. Operators cannot see what phase the chain is in, what comes next, what requires approval, or why the chain is waiting. Mission Control needs a Phase Progress strip: (1) A horizontal phase bar showing all chain phases: [✓ Phase 1: Discovery] → [⏳ Phase 2: Active Enrichment — Awaiting Approval] → [Phase 3: Credential Review] → [Phase 4: Exploitation]. (2) Current phase highlighted. Completed phases show green checkmark + duration. Waiting-for-approval phase shows amber + 'Approve to continue' button. (3) When a phase is pending approval, show a summary card: 'Phase 1 discovered 12 hosts, 3 critical findings. Ready to start Phase 2: Active Enumeration — will run nuclei CVE scans and service analysis. Estimated 25 min.' (4) Single 'Approve Phase 2' primary button when chain is in pending_phase_approval state. (5) The chain phase data is already in assessment_chain.py and returned by the runs API — this is purely a UI rendering task.
scope: Code audit 2026-05-03: assessment_chain.py has 1,854 lines with fully implemented phase definitions, auto-advance logic, and approval gating. The UI shows no phase progression strip. Operators running a FULL-INTERNAL-LAN chain cannot see they are in Phase 1, or that Phase 2 needs approval, without inspecting individual run records.
generation_reason: Chain phase progression is fully implemented in 1,854-line assessment_chain.py but completely invisible in the UI — operators don't know what phase they're in.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Render existing chain phase data. Do not change chain logic, approval mechanism, or add new chain types.

success_criteria: Mission Control shows a phase progress bar when the active run is part of an assessment chain.
Pending-approval phase shows amber + 'Approve Phase N' button.
Approve button triggers the existing phase approval endpoint.
Phase bar hidden when run is not part of a chain.
No regression in Mission Control E2E tests.

acceptance_criteria: Phase bar renders for chain runs.
